definition.def: If you have something at your disposal, you are able to use it whenever you want, and for whatever purpose you want. If you say that you are at someone's disposal, you mean that you are willing to help them in any way you can.
examples: Do you have this information at your disposal?
He has said he will use all the weapons at his disposal.
If I can be of service, I am at your disposal.

definition.def: Disposal is the act of getting rid of something that is no longer wanted or needed.
examples: ...methods for the permanent disposal of radioactive waste. [+ of]
